jurisdiction.name: Montenegro
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Montenegro has no AI-specific law or adopted AI strategy yet. Its binding AI-relevant rules are the automated decision-making and profiling provisions of two GDPR-aligned data protection laws published in September 2026, one general and one for law enforcement, which apply from March 2027; until then the 2008 data protection law applies. The first national AI Strategy 2026-2030, led by the Ministry of Public Administration with UNDP support, is still being drafted.
lead_institutions: Agency for Personal Data Protection and Free Access to Information
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 and 13 October 2026 from the official gazette and government websites; a run cut off by a usage limit was resumed and every record from it was re-checked against its official text. The draft national AI strategy is tracked as a lead.

instruments.current_status: Published 11 September 2026 in Službeni list Crne Gore No. 133/2026 (reg. no. 2294). Computed from art. 106: in force on the eighth day after publication (19 September 2026, as also stated on the gazette page) and applies six months after entry into force (gazette page: application from 19 March 2027). From that date it repeals the 2008 Law on Personal Data Protection (except arts. 35-40a on video surveillance, art. 105). Provisions referring to EU law apply from EU accession (art. 104).
instruments.scope: Montenegro (national); processing of personal data by controllers and processors
instruments.summary: Montenegro's new GDPR-aligned personal data protection law, adopted by Parliament on 4 September 2026, replaces the 2008 law and applies to controllers and processors processing personal data wholly or partly by automated means. Article 23 gives data subjects the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing, including profiling, that produces legal effects or similarly significantly affects them, with exceptions (contract, law, explicit consent) that require safeguards including human intervention, and arts. 14-16 require information on the existence and logic of automated decision-making. Under art. 35 a data protection impact assessment is required in particular for systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects based on automated processing, including profiling; supervision lies with the Agency for Personal Data Protection and Free Access to Information (art. 52).
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: General data protection law with GDPR-style rules on solely automated decision-making and profiling (art. 23) and impact assessments for automated evaluation; the main binding rule set for AI systems processing personal data in Montenegro.

instruments.scope: Montenegro (national); competent authorities processing personal data for criminal-justice purposes
instruments.summary: Law transposing the law-enforcement data protection rules for police, prosecutors and other competent authorities processing personal data for criminal-justice purposes, adopted by Parliament on 4 September 2026. Article 13 prohibits decisions based solely on automated processing, including profiling, that produce adverse legal effects or significantly affect the data subject unless provided by law with safeguards including at least the right to human intervention, bars such decisions on special categories of data without appropriate safeguards, and prohibits profiling that leads to discrimination on the basis of special categories of data; it also defines profiling and sets security rules for automated processing systems.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Binding limits on automated decision-making and profiling by law-enforcement and criminal-justice authorities (art. 13).

instruments.current_status: Published 23 December 2008 in Službeni list Crne Gore No. 79/2008; in force 30 December 2008, applied from 30 June 2009 (gazette page). Amended by Nos. 70/09, 44/12, 22/17 and 77/24 (as listed in art. 105 of the 2026 law). Still in force; repealed from 19 March 2027, the date the new Law on Personal Data Protection (No. 133/2026) applies, except arts. 35-40a on video surveillance, which lapse when a law on video surveillance enters into force.
instruments.summary: Montenegro's 2008 personal data protection law, which applies to processing of personal data carried out automatically, wholly or partly, and to manual filing systems, and set up the supervisory Agency for Personal Data Protection. It sets the legal bases, data subject rights, rules on data collections and international transfers, but the original 2008 text contains no specific rule on solely automated decision-making or profiling (later amendments were not reviewed).
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Data protection law currently governing personal data processing by AI systems in Montenegro until the 2026 law applies.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Montenegro's official gazette, parliament, government, ministries and regulators were searched. Only data protection laws were found; no AI law, pending AI bill or public-sector AI guideline was found, there was no material in the other categories, and the draft AI strategy is listed as a lead. The audiovisual media regulator's site and the standards catalogue were not checked, and whether the draft AI strategy has been put to public consultation remains to be checked.
coverage_audit.technical_note: Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-13, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. Resumed run: all 3 records re-checked 2026-10-13 against gazette pages and PDFs (dates/status unchanged; summaries corrected). aemcg.org site search not run; ISME catalogue not checked for ISO/IEC 42001. 2026 laws: lifecycle adopted, effective_date = application date (2027-03-19, 2027-03-17), in force Sep 2026. 2008 law kept in_force (repeal effective 2027-03-19). Gazette search 'vještačk': no results. Convention 108: party by 2005 State Union ratification and succession; no Montenegrin act in the gazette, so not attached. Units covered: Law: Službeni list Crne Gore title search (AI terms, data protection, Convention 108/AI convention ratification acts): no AI law or AI-specific provisions in titles; new GDPR-aligned Law on Personal Data Protection 133/2026 and law-enforcement data protection law 132/2026 (automated decision-making rules) recorded, plus 2008 law. skupstina.me search returned nothing on AI; no pending AI bill or deepfake offence found.; Government: gov.me full sitemap 2019-2026 scanned (~190 pages) for AI titles: only news on the AI strategy working group (strategy 2026-2030 still in drafting, lead), AILA readiness report (UNDP-hosted, lead), trainings, chatbots and events. Digital Transformation Strategy 2022-2026 read: AI only in passing (lead). No public-sector AI or GenAI guideline found.; Ministries: Searched via gov.me sitemap and web search: education (AI-in-education project and trainings, no guideline), health (meeting news only), justice (judiciary AI modernisation news), defence ('Digitalni ađutant' news), interior (fraud warnings), finance and labour: searched, nothing found that governs AI.; Regulators: Agency for Personal Data Protection and Free Access to Information (azlp.me): only news mentions, no AI guidance; Central Bank (cbcg.me search: no results); EKIP (no results); ISME standards leaflet (lead, undated); audiovisual media regulator and cyber authority: searched via web, nothing found.. Not reached: Agency for Audiovisual Media Services (aemcg.org) own site search not run; ISME standards catalogue (national MEST adoption of ISO/IEC 42001) not checked. Could not verify: Whether the draft AI Strategy 2026-2030 has been put to public consultation (no gov.me item found up to 2026-10-13).; AILA report text (only on undp.org).. strategy, government-governance, ethics, risk-assurance, public-sector, procurement, cyber-security, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, international: no material found.
